entries.summary: Candle cannot express OCaml physical equality/inequality at the 12 selected non-reference call sites

ocaml_reference.outcome: OCaml 4.14.1 accepts and passes both non-reference list == and list != identity oracles

candle_outcome.outcome: list == is rejected because Candle types == as reference-only; list != reaches an unsupported relational-operator parser path
evidence: timeout 20s /project/repos/candle/candle.sh < compatibility/oracles/pointer_identity_list.ml => Type mismatch between _0 ref -> _0 ref -> bool and int list -> _1 at line 2
timeout 20s /project/repos/candle/candle.sh < compatibility/oracles/pointer_identity_inequality.ml => Impossible: nRelOp; Parsing failed at line 2

chosen_remedy.description: Authenticate four original source files and apply eight ordered unique byte replacements. Explicit change results preserve filter/partition/uniq/undefine structural and unchanged-object behavior; selected-graph qmap and unsuppress calls fail closed; Jordan binder exclusion uses structural equality with an explicit alpha/name-fingerprint boundary.

proof_obligation.description: Local differential, exception-order, unchanged-sharing, zero-residual-operator, and compiled normalized-block oracles pass. The obligation remains open until the compiled direct loader applies/authenticates the overlay, the exact full selected run proves qmap/unsuppress non-use, Jordan binder spelling and final theorem/assumption fingerprints match, and Flyspeck-scale allocation/performance is accepted.
evidence: Candle 8682a8d: schema-2 normalization contract with four entries/eight operations
Candle 5522cdd: integrated direct-loader branch and static #load evidence
candle/flyspeck_identity_ocaml_oracle.ml: exhaustive lists through length five, callback/exception order, sharing, trie, fail-closed, and Jordan boundary
candle/check_flyspeck_normalized_identity.py: zero executable ==/!= operators in all four outputs
candle/test_flyspeck_identity_normalization.sh: OCaml and compiled Candle normalized oracles pass
candle/compatibility/identity_normalization_audit.md: measured local allocation overhead and open release gates

entries.notes: The source remedy is implemented and locally regression-tested, but not promoted. qmap and unsuppress are deliberately selected-graph non-use refinements; any caller drift aborts. Jordan structural exclusion can choose a differently spelled alpha-equivalent binder for separately allocated equal variables, so exact selected-run fingerprints remain promotion-blocking. The full loader has not yet applied the overlay.

entries.summary: Candle rejects the selected OCaml immediate-int n == 1 LP verifier branch

ocaml_reference.outcome: OCaml 4.14.1 accepts the n == 1 shape and evaluates it true

candle_outcome.outcome: type failure: Candle's == expects references, not ints
evidence: timeout 20s /project/repos/candle/candle.sh < compatibility/oracles/pointer_identity_immediate.ml => Type mismatch between _0 ref -> _0 ref -> bool and int -> _1 at line 2

chosen_remedy.description: Authenticate the pinned source, replace the unique exact LP branch line `if n == 1 then [] else` with `if n = 1 then [] else`, and authenticate the normalized byte count, MD5, and SHA-256 before parsing.

proof_obligation.description: The chosen normalization preserves the branch for every OCaml int: pinned OCaml 4.14.1 maps == through %eq to Pintcomp Ceq and specializes structural = on int to the same primitive; the injective tagged immediate representation independently agrees.
evidence: Candle commit 02c3493f6df6cb4b0845b14994bacef0c05a8163: 7 normalizer tests and OCaml/Candle branch oracles pass

entries.notes: This is an integer value test expressed with OCaml physical equality, not evidence that the proof code intends allocated-object identity. The exact transform and proof are complete on Candle branch codex/flyspeck-v13-immediate-normalization, but the full regression remains pending until the compiled direct loader applies and authenticates the transform before parsing build entry 182.
